decisions.title: Different experiences for different roles
decisions.recommendation: Customer, Owner and Admin share foundations but use role-specific hierarchy, navigation and density.
decisions.reason: Consistency does not mean identical experience.

decisions.title: Customer financial privacy
decisions.recommendation: Customer sees booking-relevant total, deposit and remaining amount only.
decisions.reason: Commission, owner net, wallet and payout internals do not support the Customer decision.

decisions.title: Error is not empty
decisions.recommendation: Canonical request failure always receives an error/retry state rather than a credible zero/empty presentation.

decisions.title: No decorative bootstrap delay
decisions.recommendation: Permit a branded mobile launch state only while a real session/bootstrap operation is pending; transition immediately when ready.
decisions.reason: Users should not click through branding to reach existing work.

decisions.title: Admin entry policy
decisions.recommendation: Admin uses Login or validated shell plus scoped skeleton/loading—not a full-screen decorative Splash.
decisions.reason: Admin work is operational and time-sensitive.

decisions.title: Customer journey hierarchy
decisions.recommendation: Lead with real imagery, price/location/dates and booking progress; show payment/chat only when their canonical booking state permits it.
decisions.reason: Supports travel choice and reassurance without operational complexity.

decisions.title: Owner Home begins with action
decisions.recommendation: Order Home around work requiring action, current/upcoming bookings, property health, meaningful money and messages.
decisions.reason: Matches the Owner’s central operational question.

decisions.title: Plain-language Owner finance
decisions.recommendation: Show owner-relevant balances and entitlements in business language; keep technical ledger/provider terminology behind detail.
decisions.reason: Financial clarity should not require implementation knowledge.

decisions.title: Admin queues over decorative overview
decisions.recommendation: Use Overview as an actionable routing summary and prioritize queue/review context, filters and auditability.
decisions.reason: Admin’s job is operational decisions, not passive dashboard viewing.

decisions.title: Role-specific navigation
decisions.recommendation: Keep persistent destinations only for frequent role jobs; use contextual navigation for detail and state-specific work.
decisions.reason: Avoids copying mobile tabs/headers/density across roles.

decisions.title: State-aware action hierarchy
decisions.recommendation: Only valid canonical-state actions are shown; decision-critical actions dominate, destructive actions are separated.

decisions.title: Customer Favorites destination
decisions.recommendation: Favorites is an important Customer capability and must eventually be persistent and canonical through the shared backend/database architecture; this decision does not implement persistence.
decisions.reason: Founder confirmed Favorites is real product capability, not merely temporary browser state.

decisions.title: Admin chat visibility
decisions.recommendation: Admin may view booking conversation content only in legitimate operational contexts such as dispute investigation, support cases or necessary operational investigation, with minimum necessary context and auditability; authorization is not implemented by this decision sync.
decisions.reason: Founder approved contextual, accountable access rather than unrestricted browsing.

decisions.title: Prototype Admin credential presentation
decisions.recommendation: Prototype Founder-operated Admin may keep accurately prefilled credentials for convenience; this is prototype UX only, not the final production authentication/security model, and must not broaden credential exposure.
decisions.reason: Founder approved the current convenience behavior for the prototype without approving a production security model.
